review.decision: Require verified annotated release tags with non-empty bilingual user: and user-zh: What's New blocks before release jobs run, plus local --check-notes preflight
review.notes: Closes the v1.0.206 gap where an annotated tag lacking user:/user-zh: headers passed release.yml and silently omitted the version from gtmux whatsnew and Gtmux.app's What's New window.

cases.description: Release source gate and local preflight reject release tags lacking verified main CI or valid bilingual user:/user-zh: What's New blocks
cases.setup: Construct GitHub tag/CI API fixtures and tag-note files covering valid user:/user-zh: blocks, missing headers, lightweight tags, failed main CI, blank lines splitting bullets, and fenced code blocks.
cases.action: Run macos_release_source.resolve on tag pushes and macos_release_source.validate_tag_notes / --check-notes.
cases.expected: Only annotated vX.Y.Z tags targeting the exact green-CI commit with non-empty, contiguous user: and user-zh: blocks pass; lightweight tags, missing language blocks, split/orphan bullets, and fenced-only markers fail closed before goreleaser or Mac builds run.

cases.description: CI scope classifies macos_release_source guard scripts under policy-only scripts
cases.setup: Pass scripts/macos_release_source.py and scripts/macos_release_source_test.py to ci.classify.
cases.action: Evaluate ci.classify selected jobs and full flag.
cases.expected: Selecting only macos_release_source guard scripts keeps full=False and selected=[], running unit tests in the mandatory policy job without unrelated mobile or desktop builds.
